oracles: Exact float64 equality is not aligned with the contract's less-than-half-cent equivalence rule.
The prompt states the tolerance, so the fix is bounded rather than arbitrary.
Rounding each operand to cents before comparison can reject pairs such as 1.004 and 1.006 even though their distance is below half a cent.
notes: Designed to test whether models translate a numeric business rule into a precise comparison.
